# Quran Mailer

> Quran Mailer (خدمة إرسال آيات قرآنية عبر البريد الإلكتروني) is a free, open-source service that emails subscribers a randomly selected Quranic verse every day. The website is in Arabic and also lets visitors read the full Quran online.

Subscribing only requires an email address. After subscribing, the user receives a verification email and must confirm it before daily verses start arriving. Each daily email includes a link to unsubscribe. There are no accounts, fees, or ads.

The project is built with Next.js, uses MongoDB Atlas for subscriber storage, Nodemailer (Gmail) for sending email, and Vercel Cron Jobs to send the daily verse.

## Pages

- [Home](https://quran-mailer.vercel.app/): Overview of the service and an in-page Quran reader listing all surahs and their ayahs
- [Subscribe](https://quran-mailer.vercel.app/subscribe): Enter an email address to subscribe to the daily verse
- [Unsubscribe](https://quran-mailer.vercel.app/unsubscribe): Request an unsubscribe link by email
- [Contact](https://quran-mailer.vercel.app/contact): Send a message to the maintainers

## Public API

- [List of surahs](https://quran-mailer.vercel.app/api/surahs): JSON array of all 114 surahs
- [Ayahs of a surah](https://quran-mailer.vercel.app/api/surah-ayahs/1): JSON ayahs for the surah whose id is given in the path (1–114)
